content.short: SmartNETWORK is the Solana wallet portfolio tracker with real-time price updates and onchain asset insights.
content.description: SmartNETWORK provides a unified dashboard across supported networks to monitor on-chain assets and activity. It consolidates SOL balances, DeFi positions, program activity, Candy Machines, and storage in one place, while delivering real-time price updates and performance metrics for tokens. Users gain in-depth insights into DeFi positions, staking rewards, and yield farming activities, enabling a comprehensive, bird’s-eye view of on-chain activity across Solana, Ethereum, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon, Avalanche, and Fantom.
content.meta: SmartNETWORK tracks SOL balances, DeFi positions, programs, Candy Machines, and storage. Discover SmartNETWORK and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
